top_issues: skins.png: The saved skin’s thumbnail is visibly blurred, making it difficult to identify at a glance.
content.png: Pagination shows only eight of eleven installed items despite substantial horizontal space, adding navigation to a short list.
sync.png: The saved file choices and exclusions appear as dense inline text, making the scope of synchronization harder to scan.
content.png: Table headers, filenames, and pagination metadata are small and faint, reducing scanability in the densest view.
discover.png: Result descriptions, bylines, and download counts have weak contrast and undersized text relative to the row titles.
home.png: Card borders and the playtime chart baseline are overly subtle against the atmospheric background, weakening surface and data separation.
downloads.png: lower two-thirds of the page is empty; the Finished card leaves a large dead zone with no filler or density adjustment
home.png: Sun and Tue chart bars render as nothing (0 playtime) with no zero-value baseline marker, making the axis look like a skipped day
content.png: the Instance dropdown in the header sits right-aligned and slightly below the title baseline, breaking the header alignment used on other pages
instances.png: General tab panel rows have generous vertical gaps while the Saved runtime card is much denser, creating uneven rhythm in the two columns
downloads.png: large dead empty area below the Finished list leaves the page underfilled at full window size
instances.png: right-hand instance detail card is roughly half empty at the bottom, wasting vertical space
sync.png: 'Saved file choices' uses an inline middot-separated list with a loose 'Not included' line that reads cluttered rather than structured
content.png: lock glyph embedded inside the Fabric API toggle is an ambiguous affordance (locked toggle vs required-mod badge)
discover.png: the 'Installed' state button for Entity Culling is very low-contrast and reads as disabled rather than a completed state
home.png: The hero card carries a large empty band between the action buttons and the stats row, leaving it visually bottom-heavy.
instances.png: The 'Saved runtime' card duplicates Memory/Java values already editable in the Runtime and Java tabs, creating redundant controls for the same settings.
skins.png: The Zoom in/out/reset pill overlays the top of the preview canvas where the model renders, and the preview area is mostly empty around the small character.
instances.png: the lower half of the right pane and the area under the Saved runtime card are empty, so the page feels bottom-light and unbalanced.
discover.png: the Install buttons use a dim tinted purple with low contrast on the dark card, and they read weaker than the Search control and the Installed chip.
content.png: the lock icon beside Fabric API is tiny and faint, so the required-by relationship is hard to read.
skins.png: the saved-skin row mixes a bordered Preview button with a text-style Favorite action, and the Manage button's weight differs from the Import PNG primary.
accounts.png: the Aurelia row shows a disabled-looking Selected chip while NorthStar_Builds shows Select, so the row action language is inconsistent.
settings.png: the accent swatch row and the Custom... control use small labels that are dense compared with the generous spacing elsewhere.
